purpose: Freeze the #517 volatility-matched Stage-2 baseline before any abnormal-day replication P&L is opened, so a future Stage-1 survivor must demonstrate incremental value beyond ex-ante volatility regime, time-of-day, instrument mix and direction-pattern exposure rather than receiving a post-result comparator.
scientific_question: Conditional on the same ex-ante trailing-volatility state, period/validation half, instrument set, signal hour and source direction pattern, does the abnormal-day candidate outperform deterministic non-candidate control days after identical costs and fixed portfolio sizing?

formation.source_candidate_day_definition: any UTC day containing at least one event in the exact regenerated abnormal-day candidate schedule across the fixed BTC/ETH/SOL instruments
formation.eligible_pool: For every leg in the source block, the candidate control day must preserve the source period/validation half and signal hour; have at least 90 fully observed prior completed UTC days; have finite positive trailing reference standard deviation within the frozen 1.25 symmetric ratio caliper of that source leg; have continuous bars from 00:00 through the decision hour; have the required next-hour entry and next-UTC-midnight exit bars; keep the signal, entry and exit wholly inside the same frozen period/validation half; remain before protected OOS; and not be any regenerated abnormal-day candidate signal day.
formation.matching_order: deterministic scarcity-first: compute eligible control-day sets outcome-blind; process source blocks by ascending eligible-pool size, then source UTC day, then canonical block signature
formation.ranking_rule: Within each source block's currently unused eligible pool, minimize lexicographically (maximum per-leg abs(log(control_reference_std/source_reference_std)), mean per-leg abs(log(control_reference_std/source_reference_std)), SHA256(contract_id + '|' + source_block_signature + '|' + control_utc_day)).
selection_features_allowed: source direction labels needed only for matching
past completed bars needed for the frozen 90-day reference standard deviation

stage2_use.required_comparison: candidate must beat this volatility-matched baseline after identical costs in both training and validation; otherwise reject or deprioritize complexity

contract_digest_rule: SHA256(canonical JSON with sorted keys and compact separators, excluding contract_sha256)
